howto: Press PLAY NOW, then pick a difficulty and a map.
Choose a defender from the shop and tap a glowing green spot beside the road, or drag it onto the field.
Press START WAVE. Defenders fire on their own, and every popped pod pays credits.
Tap a placed defender to buy one of its three upgrade paths, or to sell it.
Stop all 40 waves before the pods break through the gate.
tips: Camo pods are invisible to most defenders. The Eagle Lookout, Otter River Patrol, Owl and Raccoon see them, and a Dolphin reveals them for its neighbours.
Lead pods ignore sharp damage. Bring explosive, cold, energy or normal damage for them.
The Honey Badger Orchard earns credits after every cleared wave. Build it early and it pays for itself.
Royal Rush charges as you pop pods. Press R (or RUSH) when it reaches 100% to overdrive every defender for 9 seconds.
Once your defence holds, switch to 2× or 3× speed, or turn on AUTO to start each wave for you.
Stuck? Hint reads your field: it names the next threat and the best upgrade you can afford.

controls.keyboard: Click a defender card, then a green spot (or drag it). Number keys pick defenders in the open category, Space starts the wave, R fires Royal Rush, Esc deselects, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a category and a defender, then tap a green spot or drag the card onto the field. Tap a placed defender to upgrade or sell it.

difficulty: Choose on the map screen: Easy (40 gate HP, 800 credits, gentler pods), Medium (30 HP, 700 credits), Hard (20 HP, 600 credits, tougher pods) or Impoppable (1 HP, 450 credits). Within a mission the pods get tougher and faster wave by wave.

cheats.effect: +5,000 credits now and at the start of every mission
Every defender unlocked, whatever your rank
Every air-pod and carrier moves at half speed

settings.sound: Sound button in the top bar; Pause > Settings (and SETTINGS on the title) has master, effects and ambience (music) volume, screen shake and particles, all saved. The arcade's How to play panel also has Music and Effects sliders.

features.wave-preview: The NEXT panel lists the coming wave's pods on screens 1200 px and wider; Hint names the next wave's threats on any screen
features.speed-control: 1×, 2× and 3× buttons in the top bar, plus AUTO to start waves by itself
features.tower-info: Tap a placed defender: its sheet shows damage, range, attack speed, damage type and its three upgrade paths. HEROES on the title lists the whole roster
features.upgrade-and-sell: The defender sheet: three paths of three tiers each (one path can go to tier 3) and a Sell button
features.star-results: KINGDOM SECURED or GATE BREACHED card with 1 to 3 stars by gate HP left, pods popped, campaign progress, REDEPLOY and MAP SELECT
features.results: End card with stars, waves reached, pods popped and campaign progress; REDEPLOY replays the map
features.tutorial: The first mission on Riverside Switchback coaches you to build and start the wave; the arcade's How to play > Replay tutorial runs it again
features.saving: Best wave per map and difficulty, rank, XP and defender mastery are kept in localStorage; a run with codes on saves none of them
features.pause: In a mission: the game's own pause button (top bar), P or the arcade's Pause open its panel, now with a tip. On the title and map screens the arcade's pause button (top right) opens the arcade menu.
features.audio: Menu and battle music with crossfades and an announcer for wave starts, boss and final waves, the first pods, cleared waves, upgrades, victory and defeat
